mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.name, u.email, u.region_id, r.full_region_name, u.favorite_crop_id, c.crop_name favorite_crop_name, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.deleted_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN region r ON u.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN crop c ON u.favorite_crop_id = c.crop_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET favorite_crop_id = #{favoriteCropId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE users SET region_id = #{regionId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE users SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT ca.analysis_id, ca.user_id, ca.region_id, ca.recommended_crop_id, ca.score, ca.created_at, c.crop_name, r.full_region_name FROM crop_analysis ca LEFT JOIN crop c ON ca.recommended_crop_id = c.crop_id LEFT JOIN region r ON ca.region_id = r.region_id WHERE ca.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ca.created_at DESC
SELECT diagnosis_id, user_id, image_url, original_file_name, predicted_disease_name, symptom_summary, created_at FROM disease_diagnosis WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE dd FROM disease_diagnosis dd INNER JOIN users u ON dd.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.status = 'DELETED' AND u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY)
DELETE ca FROM crop_analysis ca INNER JOIN users u ON ca.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.status = 'DELETED' AND u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY)
DELETE FROM users WHERE status = 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY)
